subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: If a harness cannot expose a figure this contract requires, then the system shall record an explicit unavailability naming the harness and the missing figure.
rationale: a consumer must be able to distinguish "not measurable here" from "measured as zero" *(#D-6)*
fit_criterion: in the checkpoint batch, every figure absent from a record is accompanied by an unavailability entry; zero figures are absent without one
